Lake Foscari is the first stage in the Tides of the Foscari DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.
An enchanted forest stuffed with fae mysteries and mythological entities. The perfect place to have an average adventure with zero complications.
The hyper mode for this stage can be unlocked by defeating the Avatar of Gaea (25:00) in normal mode.
Hyper mode in Lake Foscari has a +100%

Defeating the Avatar of Gaea unlocks the stage's hyper mode.
Before the Avatar of Gaea spawns, all the enemies on the screen are cleared to increase the enemy kill count. It starts off with very little health and once it is defeated, it becomes invulnerable. After a while, the enemy minimum is increased to 150; it starts to spawn its own Ghostly Apparitions 5 s after that; and it also stops being invulnerable. It increases its max health by the number of enemies killed in this run. Its health and damage are also increased by the current character's golden egg bonuses if they are selected. The max health increase is instantaneous, the healing effect is purely visual, but each time it heals it grows bigger.
